summary: You decide in the Invardia portal how much access Invardia support has, and your install enforces it.

new.title: Support access follows your portal setting
new.text: Your install applies the support level you set in the Invardia customer portal: none, read only, or extra access only during an open support session, for at most 8 hours.

new.title: Support access is checked and recorded
new.text: Every change is checked and recorded in Audit, and the product itself cannot raise or lower the level. If Invardia is unreachable, your last setting keeps applying.
new.action: Run the install once to add this feature.
